digest: HEAD 654f639 is not deployable as-is. It renames the public summary field launchRetryAttempts to launchRetries with no alias, widens cancellation markers to 'cancelled'/'timeout' against SPEC C1, and changes the stop poll default to 200ms against SPEC S3. SPEC.md still describes the old behavior, and no tests cover any of it.

issues.description: SPEC T3 names launchRetryAttempts as a public field read by external tools. The code now emits only launchRetries (grep finds no launchRetryAttempts in src/), and SPEC.md still names the old field. Consumers reading the old name get undefined with no alias, deprecation, or migration note.
issues.migration: Emit both launchRetryAttempts (deprecated) and launchRetries for one release, or revert the rename. Update SPEC T3 and add a changelog or migration note to match the decision.

issues.description: Line 20 accepts 'cancelled' and 'timeout' as cancellation markers. SPEC C1 allows only aborted, AbortError, and ABORT_ERR and forbids promoting other provider errors to cancellation. A provider timeout can now be reclassified as user cancellation, which changes terminal status and retry behavior. Whether real provider payloads use these markers is unverified.
issues.migration: Confirm the provider payload shapes. Drop 'timeout' unless it is intentionally a cancel. Either way, add a test and update SPEC C1 to match.

issues.description: The default pollMs changed from 50ms (SPEC S3) to 200ms. Stop-request latency rises by up to about 200ms. The clamp is Math.max(1, ...), while S3 specifies a 10ms floor, so the spec and code disagree on the floor as well.
issues.migration: Decide whether 200ms is intended. If yes, update S3 and the clamp floor. If not, restore 50. Document the default as part of the exported signature.

issues.description: No test files exist, and the only script is typecheck. SPEC Q1 requires a unit test per S/C/T item, so none of the three behavior changes is verified. The upstream notes also say store.js and types.js are absent from the repo, so typecheck may not resolve.
issues.migration: Add contract tests for the launchRetries field name, the cancellation marker set, and the poll default before release, and confirm typecheck runs in a complete tree.

confirmedConsistencies.evidence: src/workflow-stop.ts:67 uses Math.max(1, options.pollMs ?? 200). src/workflow-terminal.ts:33,107 declare and populate launchRetries. src/workflow-cancellation.ts:20 includes 'cancelled' and 'timeout'. All three match the upstream claims.

SPEC.md:13 gives the 50ms default, SPEC.md:25-26 gives the exact three-marker set, and SPEC.md:35 names launchRetryAttempts. The spec still states the pre-commit contract, so it is consistent with the old code and contradicts HEAD.
All three upstream control artifacts were read with path=$ and were complete (charsTruncated=false). Their findings are consistent with each other and with the grep evidence.
